commitments.detail: Perform a 30-minute ventilation purge of the battery-charging room.
Install continuous hydrogen monitoring equipment in the battery-charging room.
Document the incident in the environmental incident log.
Purge the room for 30 minutes using the ventilation system.
Implement continuous hydrogen monitoring until clearance is confirmed.
Document the incident and subsequent actions in the environmental incident record.
Purge for 30 minutes to ensure smoke has cleared.
Monitor continuously until clearance is confirmed.
Document the incident and control measures taken.
